card: Executes a scripted-diff to strip trailing newline characters from one-line logging macros across 72 files and moves a logging test into the dedicated logging test suite. The author describes this as a longstanding style cleanup intended to eliminate manual reformatting and reduce complexity during log injection discussions. No dependencies are noted.
evidence: PR description notes this has been a "low-prio style cleanup for years" and references discussion around log injection handling in #35833
problem: Logging calls frequently contain redundant trailing newlines, creating stylistic inconsistency, manual cleanup churn in unrelated pull requests, and complications when reasoning about log escaping and injection.

risk.why: Only modifies log format strings via sed regex and moves an existing unit test without changing program logic.

scope_notes: Large scripted-diff touching 72 files with an embedded verify script, preceded by a move-only unit test commit.
summary: Removes trailing newline escape sequences (`\n`) from single-line logging macro calls across the codebase using a scripted-diff. In addition, moves the `LogEscapeMessage` unit test from `util_tests` into `logging_tests`.
